== Summary ==
This group plays a fearless hand of Star Wars CCG Iron Man. Ready to shred their rares are (l. to r.) Bill, Dennis Shea (standing) and Dan, all from New York City, and Ellen, from Chicago. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]], [[1999 Decipher World Championship]], [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]], [[Dennis Shea]].
